how: Each morning, rate your mood from 1 to 5 in the app.
Answer honestly; the rating is private to the crew medical officer.

why.text: Isolation and confinement over long missions can lead to behavioral changes.
why.hrp_risk: Risk of Behavioral Changes and Psychiatric Disorders

if_abnormal.remeasure: Look at the next few days' ratings; one low day is normal.
if_abnormal.tell_ground: Raise it at the next private medical conference with the ground.

space_note: A 1 to 5 self-rating has no clinical limit, so mood has no Safety bound and is judged against the crewmember's own normal. Normal-day data come from Earth wearable users (PMData), not astronauts.
